text:
li_chen_pm: Quick thread — we need to recruit 3 design partners for a focused pilot around routing + dedicated capacity. Primary goal is to validate the integration contract (networking, auth, KMS) and our rollback/fallback policies. Need shortlist + screening questions by Wed.
maya_p: I can own outreach for 1–2 early-stage customers (PLG apps). Will take enterprise list if needed. What incentives? :moneybag:
li_chen_pm: Incentive thinking: $5k platform credit + 8 weeks of free Dedicated access + weekly office hours from eng. Also an NDA. Is that enough to move fence-sitters?
samir_eng: Sounds good. I can build the onboarding SDK stub and a one-click deploy script. ETA Fri. Will also add a small observability harness to collect latency/cost metrics.
andre_ops: We need an ops contact for each partner (networking & firewall exceptions). Also confirm they can run in our VPC peering model or accept a VPN. I can handle setup for 2 partners.
jamie_research: Proposed success metrics (short):
- Latency: median + p95 for typical prompt set (we should predefine 10 prompts)
- Cost delta vs hosted baseline (tokens / GPU-hours)
- Integration friction score (onboarding < 3 dev-days)
- Quality regressions: automated eval pass rate >= 90%
These are what we'll surface in the launch criteria.
maya_p: Screening q's draft:```
1) Typical QPS and avg seq len?
2) Do you need private models or can you use curated open models?
3) Which KMS/HSM provider (if any)?
4) Any regulatory constraints (HIPAA, SOC2)?
5) Expected traffic during pilot window?
``` Thoughts?
li_chen_pm: Good set. Add: "Who owns rollout decision internally?" and "Can you share one sample prompt + expected output?" to measure quality.
samir_eng: For onboarding we'll provide this sample curl to exercise routing fallback:```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-routing-v1","prompt":"Hello","timeout_ms":2000}'
``` That will log routing path and fallback events to our tracing.
andre_ops: Also include a short checklist we require before granting Dedicated: 
- IP allowlist
- VPN / VPC creds
- KMS access test key
- Contact for on-call
I'll paste a template in the doc later.
compliance-bot: NDA template updated by Legal on 2026-01-18 — <https://redwood.docs/nda-template>. Use the "Beta - Design Partner" variant. :white_check_mark:
jamie_research: We should lock the 10 prompt set now. I'll propose 3 LLM eval families: conversational, code-gen (short), and extraction (structured output). Will share examples today.
maya_p: Outreach plan: short email + calendar invite -> 30m tech discovery -> onboarding checklist -> 60m post-integration health check at week 2. I'll draft message and spreadsheet rows for owners.
li_chen_pm: Ok — owners: @maya_p outreach, @samir_eng SDK/onboarding, @andre_ops infra setup, @jamie_research metrics/evals. Recruit target: 3 partners, backup list of 5. Deadline: shortlist by Wed, invites out by next Mon.
maya_p: Copy. I'll post a draft outreach message here by EOD and tag the spreadsheet.
samir_eng: I'll drop the SDK repo link + quickstart into the thread once ready.
li_chen_pm: Great. One more: define what 'success' looks like for product: if two partners hit p95 latency target and cost delta < 20% vs baseline and integration time < 3 dev-days, we greenlight wider private beta. Otherwise iterate.

maya_p: Noted. Will include those as the acceptance criteria in outreach. :thumbsup:

li_chen_pm: Thanks all — small and fast. Please update the spreadsheet when you take an action so we can track owners.
